# Brain Embedding Template

Use this template for every non-trivial Brain entry.

Goal:
Create structured, scoped, searchable and embedding-friendly Brain records so future NeXify agents can retrieve accurate context.

Applies to:
- Claude Code
- Goose ACC
- Goose CLI
- ChatGPT
- Human operators

Organization:
NeXify AI by NeXify — chat it. Automate it.

## Required Structure

### Title
Short, specific, searchable.

### Scope
One of:
- nexify_internal
- customer_project
- shared_infrastructure
- general_research

### Project / Customer Boundary
State clearly:
- NeXify-owned
- customer-specific
- shared infrastructure
- cross-project but scoped

Never mix customer data across projects.

### Summary
3–8 concise sentences.

### Key Facts
- fact 1
- fact 2
- fact 3

### Decisions
- decision
- reason
- date/time Europe/Berlin
- UTC timestamp

### Constraints
- security
- DSGVO/GDPR
- tenant separation
- tool limits
- deployment limits

### Affected Systems
- repo
- files
- services
- deployments
- domains
- MCPs
- agents
- VDS paths
- Vercel project/deployment IDs
- GitHub repo/branch/PR
- Cloudflare zone/tunnel/DNS
- Supabase project/schema
- Resend domain/account
- You.com/MCP config

### Skills / Tools Used
- skills
- CLI
- MCP
- You.com
- Brain
- Claude Code
- Goose ACC
- Goose CLI

### Evidence
- commands
- checks
- logs summarized
- URLs
- file paths
- deployment checks
- health endpoints

### Risks
- risk
- mitigation

### Next Actions
- action
- owner agent
- priority

### Search Tags
Include synonyms, repo names, project names, tool names, German and English technical terms where useful.

## Do Not Store

Do not store:
- raw API keys
- passwords
- private keys
- OAuth tokens
- cookies
- unredacted database URLs
- unrelated customer data
- raw PII unless explicitly required and legally justified

Store only:
- secret reference name
- storage path
- project scope
- rotation status
- owner
- purpose
